# Hold

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Parks the call in hand so the server can receive others, and returns a ticket for it.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0D` SVC_HOLD | — | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err Hold(Ticket *out);
```

**Registers:** `() -> r0 status, r1 ticket`

The caller stays blocked until the ticket is answered with ReplyTo() (from any thread of this space) or the port dies (ERR_DEAD). A parked caller no longer lends its priority to the server. A port parks at most 64 calls.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `out` | out | Receives the ticket on success; may be NULL. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | No call in hand. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The caller died before it could be parked. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | The port's parking table is full. |
